support_claim: The identity-establishing rebrand note ties Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH to the same registry ID HRB 88421, and CRM OAK-77’s retained pre-rebrand name together with billing’s post-rebrand legal name align both referents to that single entity.

propositions.proposition: CRM account OAK-77 is recorded with the name Oakfield Logistics, domain oakfield-log.com, country DE, contact M. Weber, and status active.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the left referent crm:OAK-77 as recorded in CRM.

propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Companies House / Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
propositions.relevance: Links the pre-rebrand and post-rebrand legal names to the same unchanged registry identifier HRB 88421.

propositions.proposition: CRM still shows the old English-facing name after the rebrand to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Explains a naming discrepancy between CRM records and the post-rebrand legal name relevant to the candidate relation.

propositions.proposition: Registry row HRB 88421 lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH in Germany with status active.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the registered legal entity associated with HRB 88421 referenced in the rebrand notes.

propositions.proposition: Billing records use the billed name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the right referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH as it appears on invoices.
